name: videomaker
description: Beat-matched promo reels from your own clips, rendered on your computer: design your brand's video kit as a motion storyboard, then turn a folder of footage and a track into a finished Instagram or TikTok reel and its caption.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your clips and a track into a finished, beat-matched reel.
interface.longDescription: Sets up its own video tools on your computer, designs your brand's start and out cards and text styles as a motion storyboard, tags your footage, cuts every shot to the song's beat with the drop on cue, renders a 1080x1920 MP4 and writes the post caption.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second reel for our free week from my clips.
Set up our video template: logo, colours, hours and offer.
